title: Multi-neighborhood demonstrations against water and electricity rationing
location: Itaosy, 67 Ha, Andranomanalina, Ankadifotsy, Ampasampito and Andranomena, Antananarivo
scope: Report-level cluster across six neighborhoods on 4 November; no evidence of common organization; no counts are aggregated.
organizer: Residents in several neighborhoods; no organizer named.
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance estimates by site; counts cannot be combined.

start_date.summary: Madagascar-Tribune’s 5 November report says the neighborhoods saw demonstrations yesterday, fixing date at 4 November (lines 22–25).

end_date.summary: Report says calm returned around 22:00 but does not state if this applied to all sites (line 26).

organizer.summary: Residents are identified; no common organizer or coordination is named.

demands.summary: The actions are described as against water/electricity rationing; report says presidential explanations and promises had not calmed consumers (lines 24–25).

participants_original.summary: No attendance estimates reported at any site.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No per-site count or clear qualitative size; do not aggregate across sites.

protester_violence.summary: Source says some protesters threw stones at police and an officer was reportedly injured at 67 Ha (line 26).

state_response.summary: Police tried to intervene; reinforcements were called and the report says forces repressed the movements (lines 25–26); arrests not reported for these sites.

notes: Pending event-unit, threshold and State-target determinations; not coded as one confirmed event.
open_questions: Was each neighborhood action a distinct gathering or was there common organization?
How many people attended each site simultaneously?
What specific State or policy demand was made beyond objection to outages?
Which locations had stone-throwing or police intervention?
Are these actions linked to October protests or separate local mobilizations?
